title: Prediction Index — forecasts, standing claims, tests, historical theses and priority records
description: 4385 claims read out of the archive's deposits by the prediction sweep (2026-10-15) and its second reading pass over repaired text and attachments (2026-10-18), and grouped by its triage, topical and join passes (2026-10-17, 2026-10-18): each registered at its earliest statement, every statement quoted. predecessors.relation: A structural extraction (38 numbered predictions, 152 predictive assertions). This index reads every deposit in full and supersedes its counts; it is kept as the record of the earlier pass.
